title: Sorting reorders only the active tab's rows; Totals stays at the bottom
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. At least two tabs have several rows each.
steps:
1. In the active tab, sort by a column and note the new order.
  2. Check the position of the Totals row.
  3. Switch to another tab and check its row order.
expected:
1. Sorting reorders the rows within the active tab only.
2. The Totals row stays pinned at the bottom, out of the sort.
3. The other tab's order is not changed by the first tab's sort action.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S4-R28), read on 18 August 2026.
